# laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key (Resource)

Manages an access key for a Laravel Cloud storage bucket.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) Parent storage bucket ID.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `permission` (String) Key permission: read_write or read_only.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3-compatible access key ID.
- `access_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) S3-compatible secret access key.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

A key is only addressable through its bucket, so the import ID is
`<bucket_id>:<key_id>` — not the key id on its own:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key.key fls-abc123:flsk-def456
```
